# Connection

A typed connection to an outside system: settings here, the credentials in the secret store.

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec.config` | object (map of string) | No |  | Non-secret settings, for example `host`, `port`, `database`, `bucket`, `baseUrl`. | max 32 |
| `spec.ownerGroup` | string (nullable) | No |  | Scope `group`: the Keycloak group whose members manage and use the connection. | min 1, max 64; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` |
| `spec.refreshInterval` | string | No | `15m` | How often the synced Secret is refreshed from the store, for example `15m`. Between one minute and 24 hours. | pattern `^[0-9]{1,4}(m\|h)$` |
| `spec.scope` | string | No | `group` | Whose credential a connection holds and who may use it. Personal connections have no resource: they live only in the secret store and never reach a pipeline. | `group`, `managed` |
| `spec.secret` | object | Yes |  | Where the secret part of a connection lives. |  |
| `spec.secret.keys` | array of string | Yes |  | Names of the secret fields, for example `user` and `password`. They become the keys of the synced Kubernetes Secret and the environment variables `CONN_<NAME>_<KEY>`. | min 1, max 16 |
| `spec.secret.remoteRef` | string (nullable) | No |  | Path in the secret store. Absent: derived from the scope, `connections/group/<ownerGroup>/<name>` or `connections/managed/<name>`. Set it only when the platform reads the customer's own store (`spec.secrets` mode `external`); in platform mode the controller refuses a value, because a path chosen by the author could point at another group's secret. | min 1, max 512; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_./-]*$` |
| `spec.type` | string | Yes |  | What a connection reaches. The type decides which settings and secret keys are required. | `postgresql`, `mysql`, `sqlserver`, `oracle`, `rest-api`, `s3`, `kafka`, `sftp`, `generic` |
| `spec.usableBy` | array of string | No |  | Scope `managed`: the groups whose platform-run work may use the connection. | max 20 |

## Validation rules

- a group connection needs ownerGroup and no usableBy
- a managed connection needs usableBy and no ownerGroup
- usableBy must list group names (letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash)
- secret.remoteRef must not contain .. or //
- secret.keys must be unique names of letters, digits and underscore
- config holds settings, not secrets: a name like password, secret or token belongs in secret.keys
- a database connection needs config.host and the secret keys user and password
- a rest-api connection needs config.baseUrl and the secret key token, or clientId and clientSecret
- an s3 connection needs config.bucket and the secret keys accessKeyId and secretAccessKey
- an sftp connection needs config.host and the secret keys user and password or privateKey
- a kafka connection needs config.bootstrapServers
